tokens.name: ad-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind cards, in the main column and the top bar.

tokens.name: ad-panel
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus, table cells, inputs.

tokens.name: ad-panel-2
tokens.usage: Insets inside a card: table heads, wells, the quote summary, file preview frame.

tokens.name: ad-ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ad-bg, ad-panel and ad-panel-2 (15:1 light, 16:1 dark). The focus colour.

tokens.name: ad-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, metadata on ad-bg, ad-panel and ad-panel-2 (at least 5.8:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: ad-line
tokens.usage: Card and input borders, table rules, dividers.

tokens.name: ad-line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger borders: hovered inputs, empty strip segments, timeline rails.

tokens.name: ad-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav links and list items; the selected list item fill.

tokens.name: ad-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected chip fill: navy in light, #b84a00 in dark. Label is ad-on-fill.

tokens.name: ad-on-fill
tokens.usage: Label on ad-fill (white: 15:1 on navy, 5.23:1 on #b84a00).

tokens.name: ad-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: ad-dot
tokens.usage: Unread dots and small orange marks. Never carries words.

tokens.name: ad-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange text: links, the next time in a list, the deck tool hints. #b84a00 in light (4.9:1 on ad-bg), #ff6500 in dark (6.4:1 on ad-panel).

tokens.name: ad-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2px, offset 2px). Ink, never orange.

tokens.name: ad-tone-good
tokens.usage: Solid status fill: paid, approved, on track, done. White label 5.02:1.

tokens.name: ad-tone-warn
tokens.usage: Solid status fill: due soon, waiting, needs approval. White label 4.92:1.

tokens.name: ad-tone-bad
tokens.usage: Solid status fill: late, blocked, failed, notification count. White label 5.62:1.

tokens.name: ad-bad-ink
tokens.usage: Red text on ad-panel: destructive menu items, overdue notes, Sign out.

tokens.name: ad-tone-live
tokens.usage: Solid orange fill for words: in progress, money in a list, new. White label 5.23:1.

tokens.name: ad-tone-neutral
tokens.usage: Solid neutral fill: to do, draft, scheduled later. White label.

tokens.name: ad-tone-flat
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for counts and disabled controls. Text is ad-on-flat.

tokens.name: ad-on-flat
tokens.usage: Text on ad-tone-flat.

tokens.name: ad-tone-brand
tokens.usage: Solid navy fill for meetings, retainers, brand service tags, avatars. White label.

tokens.name: ad-hero
tokens.usage: The deck card and dark heroes. Text is white; secondary text ad-hero-dim.

tokens.name: ad-hero-line
tokens.usage: Border of ad-hero surfaces.

tokens.name: ad-hero-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ad-hero (12.6:1).

tokens.name: ad-series-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (invoiced), stepper done, timeline dots.

tokens.name: ad-series-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (collected), strip progress. Orange as a mark, never text.

tokens.name: ad-ring
tokens.usage: The 4px halo around a focused input or selected option.

tokens.name: ad-nav-on
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill: navy in light, white in dark.

tokens.name: ad-nav-on-ink
tokens.usage: Active nav item label: white in light, navy in dark.

tokens.name: ad-act
tokens.usage: Deck card primary action fill (#b84a00, 3.38:1 against ad-hero, white label 5.23:1).

tokens.name: ad-act-hover
tokens.usage: Deck card primary hover: green #15803d (white 5.02:1, 3.52:1 against ad-hero).

tokens.name: ad-stage
tokens.usage: The preview stage behind the device frame. Not used inside the product.

tokens.name: ad-on-tone
tokens.usage: Label and icon on every ad-tone-* fill except ad-tone-flat, and on ad-act.
